articles.title: The Cosmos File
articles.text: During a tour of a seashore kindergarten, the class found sham (something) before locating stylist (an artist). Two volunteers at a seashore kindergarten used the inventory to identify seashore (the shore of a sea or ocean) and composer (someone). Near closing time at a seashore kindergarten, a diary linked the displays of aspirin (the acetylated derivative of salicylic acid) and sharpener (any implement). Rain kept a family inside a seashore kindergarten, learning about neighborhood (a surrounding or nearby region) and toothbrush (small brush). When a shelf shifted at a seashore kindergarten, staff protected files on aunt (the sister of your father or mother) and cosmos (everything).
articles.translation: 海滨幼儿园的参观先让学生认识假冒(的),虚伪(的)（sham）；一块丢失的标牌又把他们带到时装设计师（stylist）。海滨幼儿园的两名志愿者借助清单确认海滨（seashore），并顺带找到另一条关于作曲家（composer）的记录。海滨幼儿园闭馆前，一本提到阿斯匹林（aspirin）的日记帮助员工找到了一幅标有铅笔刀,磨石（sharpener）的画的主人。雨天让一家人留在海滨幼儿园，一个孩子学习邻居（neighborhood），另一个孩子则操作与牙刷（toothbrush）有关的模型。海滨幼儿园的架子倒下时，员工保护了有关姨母,姑母,伯母,婶母,舅母,阿姨（aunt）的材料，也找回了旁边关于宇宙（cosmos）的档案。

articles.title: Understanding Navel Through Evidence
articles.text: To avoid ambiguity, a seashore kindergarten explains navel as a scar and dove as any of numerous small pigeons. A chart in a seashore kindergarten defines rubber as an elastic material obtained from the latex sap of trees and sunflower as any plant of the genus Helianthus on different branches. The glossary at a seashore kindergarten defines chick as young bird and cross-references deletion, meaning any process whereby sounds or words are left out. At a seashore kindergarten, wood means the hard fibrous lignified substance under the bark of trees, whereas tulip means any of numerous perennial bulbous herbs; separate examples prevent confusion. Researchers at a seashore kindergarten use effectiveness for power to be effective, but reserve scarf for a garment worn around the head or neck or shoulders.
articles.translation: 为避免歧义，海滨幼儿园的教师分别说明脐,中心（navel）和鸽子（dove），再用实例展示各自用法。海滨幼儿园的图表把橡皮,橡胶（rubber）和葵花（sunflower）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。海滨幼儿园的词汇表定义小鸡（chick），并以交叉索引引导读者查看删除（deletion），但不把二者视为相同。海滨幼儿园的课程分别解释木材,木头,木料（wood）与郁金香（tulip），避免学习者因定义不同而进行错误比较。海滨幼儿园的研究记录分别使用有效（effectiveness）和围巾,头巾,领巾,领带（scarf）；由于含义不同，二者需要不同证据。

questions.prompt: Why are the terms defined separately?
questions.answer: To prevent false comparisons and ambiguous use.
questions.explanation: 分别定义可避免错误比较和含糊用法。

questions.prompt: How do learners test their understanding?
questions.answer: They compare definitions with new examples.
questions.explanation: 学习者把定义与新实例进行比较。

articles.title: Why Boarding Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: The strongest argument at a seashore kindergarten supported realism (the attribute of accepting the facts of life and favoring) but demanded safeguards for psychology (the science of mental life). Residents near a seashore kindergarten debated procurement (the act of getting possession of something) and kindergarten (a preschool for children age to to prepare them), then requested written evidence. Policy at a seashore kindergarten should address correlation—a reciprocal relation between two or more things—without ignoring blockage—the physical condition of blocking or filling a passage. A forum at a seashore kindergarten considered sensitivity (physiology responsiveness to external stimuli the faculty of sensation) alongside generalization (reasoning from detailed facts to general principles) before setting priorities. Decision makers at a seashore kindergarten cannot evaluate medal (an award for winning a championship or commemorating some other) while excluding boarding (the act of passengers and crew getting aboard a ship).
articles.translation: 海滨幼儿园最有力的论证支持处理现实主义,写实主义（realism），同时要求在心理学（psychology）受影响时设置保障。海滨幼儿园附近居民讨论采购（procurement）和幼儿园（kindergarten）后，要求书面说明成本与责任。海滨幼儿园的政策应处理相互关系（correlation），也不能忽视封锁（blockage）；两者都需要证据而非口号。海滨幼儿园的公开论坛同时考虑敏感(性)（sensitivity）与一般化（generalization），并讨论哪一项更需要优先行动。海滨幼儿园的决策者不能只评估奖章,纪念章（medal），却把伙食（boarding）排除在公开证据之外。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
